```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = {
    'StichtagDat': ['2024-12-31', '2025-12-31', '2019-12-31', '2020-12-31', '2021-12-31'],
    'AlterV10Lang': ['30- bis 39-Jährige'] * 5,
    'AnzHunde': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
    'KreisLang': ['Kreis 7', 'Kreis 7', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create a count plot of the number of dogs by KreisLang
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(data=df, x='KreisLang', hue='AlterV10Lang', palette='Set2')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Number of Dogs by Kreis and Age Group', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Kreis', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Age Group')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the figure
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
```
